purpose: QA-only fixed visual-reference comparison. Seven development clips are calibration only; acceptance requires a frozen subject-disjoint evaluation.
selectionNote: Selected from the already inspected development cache before held-out evaluation; no held-out images, labels or model outputs were used to select these references.
limitations: The two stills show different movement phases and framing. They illustrate a visible contour distinction, not a universal geometric template or clinical spinal diagnosis. The GB still is a lowering hinge, not a bottom-position exemplar. A model may still transfer appearance or copy a conclusion despite valid target citations; blinded target-image review remains necessary.
